selection: first eligible (user_id, timestamp, event_id); no labels or scores
history_requirement: earliest window member has a full prior rolling window; endpoint has a successor in the same split; both edited positions have positive bytes_sent
recompute: all events of the affected user in the selected split, using the original frozen builder and train state
prepared_numeric_boundary: original float32 feature builder -> pandas CSV writer -> original pandas CSV reader; LSTM then casts to float32
oracle: independent full-split call to the original builder; inputs, membership, scores and decisions must match exactly

functional_fixture.purpose: engineering validation only; no detection-quality claim
functional_fixture.scope: one fixture setup per functional suite run and one retained demonstration; existing regression fixtures remain unchanged
